fw_trail.facing: travel = up (-y); rotate to velocity + PI/2

fw_burst_magenta.timing: f0 white flash, f1-3 expand (ease-out), f4-7 fade to 0; no hold frame

fw_burst_cyan.timing: f0 white flash, f1-3 expand (ease-out), f4-7 fade to 0; no hold frame

fw_burst_gold.timing: f0 white flash, f1-3 expand (ease-out), f4-7 fade to 0; no hold frame

fw_burst_green.timing: f0 white flash, f1-3 expand (ease-out), f4-7 fade to 0; no hold frame

fw_spark.note: f0 dot, f1 cross twinkle, f2 streak (rotate to velocity), f3 ember; white so the burst colour can be tinted with a 'source-atop' pass or left white

fw_glow_magenta.draw: radius 64 wu at peak (draw 128x128 wu), alpha 0.85 -> 0 linear over 0.6 s; drawn 4r square, r 64 wu; scale 0.7->1.0 over f0-f2

fw_glow_cyan.draw: radius 64 wu at peak (draw 128x128 wu), alpha 0.85 -> 0 linear over 0.6 s; drawn 4r square, r 64 wu; scale 0.7->1.0 over f0-f2

fw_glow_gold.draw: radius 64 wu at peak (draw 128x128 wu), alpha 0.85 -> 0 linear over 0.6 s; drawn 4r square, r 64 wu; scale 0.7->1.0 over f0-f2

fw_glow_green.draw: radius 64 wu at peak (draw 128x128 wu), alpha 0.85 -> 0 linear over 0.6 s; drawn 4r square, r 64 wu; scale 0.7->1.0 over f0-f2

fw_glow2_magenta.fade: globalAlpha = (1 - t/0.9)^2, t in s; x0.5 under reduced motion

fw_glow2_cyan.fade: globalAlpha = (1 - t/0.9)^2, t in s; x0.5 under reduced motion

fw_glow2_gold.fade: globalAlpha = (1 - t/0.9)^2, t in s; x0.5 under reduced motion

fw_glow2_green.fade: globalAlpha = (1 - t/0.9)^2, t in s; x0.5 under reduced motion

fw_sdot_magenta.note: D29 spark: draw 6x6 wu (3 wu core), alpha = 1 - age/life

fw_sdot_cyan.note: D29 spark: draw 6x6 wu (3 wu core), alpha = 1 - age/life

fw_sdot_gold.note: D29 spark: draw 6x6 wu (3 wu core), alpha = 1 - age/life

fw_sdot_green.note: D29 spark: draw 6x6 wu (3 wu core), alpha = 1 - age/life

fw_shell.note: D29 shell: drawn at ground pos + lift 36*4t(1-t) wu toward -y; scale 1+0.25*lift/36

hud_glyph.use: INSIDE D29's .pill.gold chip (HUD A chip_sm_gold 9-slice / hud=old pill): 16x16 before or instead of the label, vertical-align:-3px; margin-right:6px
hud_glyph.state_map: 0 charges=empty, 1-2=partial, 3 (FW_MAX)=full; or one glyph per charge (3 glyphs) instead of the ●●○ dots

hud.use: inside an A8 chip_sm (e.g. chip_sm_curb) as a leading icon, background-size: 24px 24px

timing.launch: trail 0.6-0.9 s at 24 fps loop, rise 260-360 wu
timing.glow: peak 0.85 alpha at burst start, linear to 0 by 0.6 s
timing.smoke: life 1.6 s, alpha=life*0.45, r grows 6->18 wu

shell.fizz: fw_spark f0/f1 alternating 30 Hz at the shell, 2 px (~2.3 wu @0.88)

ring.stroke: 2 css px (2/zoom wu) primary colour, alpha 1 - t/0.35, canvas arc (no sprite)

d29.burst_sprite: fw_burst_<colour> still drawn (0.667 s) as the bright core; optional
d29.trail: fw_trail optional (A15.launch), not used by D29 throw
d29.reduced_motion: A15.RM = true -> glow + sparks x0.5 alpha (camFlash/shake are Code's)
